The confirmatory block and the two baseline runs are all running. I'm ending the turn until jobs end.

- **Answers to #11:**
  - **Confirmed:** the variance slopes, the absolute-R² numbers, the cell/D*/ties definitions and the appendix numbers all match the code and tables.

- **GNN baseline:** it is feasible and queued as 14 jobs, one per Tier A cell.
  - It is a 2-layer mean-aggregation network on the observed graph. Weight decay and epoch count are chosen by cluster hold-out plus corner loss, as for the other learners.
  - It runs on the same assignments as the other estimators. I checked this by recomputing the Chin estimate inside the run, which matched exactly.
  - It uses 50 draws per cell instead of 200, because a fit costs about 10–20 s on the loaded host. The deliverable will say so.
- **Cluster Horvitz–Thompson:** the Hájek (self-normalised) form is already in the cells for the cluster designs. I added the unnormalised Horvitz–Thompson columns, `ht75` and `ht100`, and reran the cluster runs as 4 jobs.
  - The rerun reproduces the original arrays on a 5-draw test. The full check with `check_rerun.py` comes when the jobs end.
  - The block jobs had already started before I edited `sim.py`, so they ran the old code. The edit only appends columns.
- **Aggregation:** `aggregate_all.sh` and the export list now include `make_gnn.py`, `make_ht.py` and a `check_rerun.py` comparison of the Horvitz–Thompson rerun against D.
